notes: TIERS (164 rows): strict in-definition and plant confirmed by a page 33; boundary but confirmed 34 (Dexter axle plants x17 whose product per plant is not stated, Lippert RV/manufactured-housing chassis and axle plants x15, CURT light-vehicle hitches, Navistar West Point assembly); in-definition company-level only 93; out of definition 4. Boundary rows flagged in note: Lippert RV and manufactured-housing chassis plants (17 rows, 'chassis frames for towables'), Dexter plants whose individual product is not stated, CURT light-vehicle hitches, SAF-Holland Wylie (machining/assembly, 2009 source), Navistar West Point (assembly plant). Aluminum-first rows are marked (Wilson x4, East, Exiss, Featherlite, Lakota, Shadow, Sundowner, 4-Star, Hart, Elite, Reitnouer, RC). Multi-building sites are one row each (Carry-On Lavonia 3 buildings, Missouri Valley 2, Madill CM 3). Size: most rows have no headcount; known scale: Load Trail 500+ employees/3 sites, Exiss 130 at El Reno, Titan 160, Doosan Bobcat Statesville 930, Hendrickson Ohio ~300 planned, Iron Bull 435,000 sq ft. Coverage not attempted or not resolved: Wabash (Lafayette), Hyundai Translead (Mexico), Fontaine Haleyville plant confirmation, Kaufman, Eager Beaver, Etnyre, Load King and Pitts plant pages (sites unreachable or 403/502), B&W Hitches, Shocker Hitch, Sure-Trac, Larson Electronics, Aspen, Benson, Doonan/Rogers pages (proxy 502), Continental Cargo, Look/Haulmark/Wells Cargo (no source in this run), boat brands Venture/Boatmate/AmeraTrail/Waterland, SAF-Holland suspension plants, Hendrickson's other trailer plants, Utility's other plants.
